verdict.rationale: The pack documents no way for a user to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent. The ACP delegated payment token is a single-use payment nonce with amount and time limits, which is a payment credential and not a scoped API key. The MCP server's OAuth metadata lists only identity scopes (openid/email/profile), and the REST APIs use general OAuth 2 access tokens with no per-agent permission scoping. These are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
